newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Two airliners in near miss over Estonia - agency.
newsitem.headline: Two airliners in near miss over Estonia - agency.

text.p: Two airliners came dangerously close to each other over the small Baltic state of Estonia last week, the Baltic News Service (BNS) news agency quoted aviation officials as saying on Tuesday.

The agency quoted the aviation department's air disaster department head Tonu Sepp as saying that a Japan Airlines Boeing 747 and an Air France Airbus 340 came within 200 metres (656 feet) of each other over the town of Vohma in central Estonia.
The airliners got so close that a warning alarm came on in one of the planes cockpits, the agency added.
The Japan Airlines plane was en route from Tokyo to Frankfurt while the Air France jet was heading from Seoul to Paris, the agency added.
